fixes.lever_rationale: 3 evidence ref(s) cite tool calls that succeeded — the sequence, not the tool; 1/3 unsupported claims overlap a memory entry read; 2 evidence ref(s) cite error/tool spans; signals are mixed; llm tiebreak: Evidence is minimal and non-specific: reviewer notes only that the case was marked a miss and later escalated by another team; no details on whether the agent held incorrect beliefs (knowledge), followed incorrect steps (procedure), or had tool/prompt/control bugs (code). Memory-attribution lifts are moderate but entries are marked implicated=False, so they don't indicate a clear incorrect memory leading to failure. Given the lack of concrete failure mode indicators in the provided refs and revi; repair agent drafted the change
fixes.title: Fix: Sparse or missing reviewer rationale
fixes.summary: 3 failing runs graded by jev-demo-decision-failure. Evidence: “review: Reviewer marked this one a miss; no detail recorded.”.

corrective_entry.value: {"goal": "Always include a specific, audit-ready rationale in the review for each routing decision.", "steps": ["Extract key lead facts: company size (employees/seats), region/timezone, industry, contact role, stated intent/signals (e.g., demo request, pricing question, budget approved), and any constraints or timelines.", "Identify the segment and routing rule that applies and confirm the chosen action.", "Compose the review: state the action and cite at least two concrete facts (with values) plus the rule/threshold that justified the action.", "Note uncertainties or missing information and the next step (e.g., request clarification, set lower confidence, or escalate) instead of writing vague phrases.", "If the case was escalated or later marked a miss, include what changed (new facts or rule exception) that explains the change."], "on_failure": "If the draft review contains vague phrases like 'no detail recorded' or 'root cause unclear', or lacks concrete facts/rule reference, revise it to include specific facts and the applied rule; if facts are truly unavailable, explicitly list what is missing and why, and adjust confidence or escalate accordingly.", "verify": "Before finalizing, check that the review includes: (1) the action name, (2) at least two concrete facts (numbers, regions, roles, or intent signals), and (3) a brief rule/threshold rationale; also confirm it does not contain banned vague phrases like 'no detail recorded' or 'root cause unclear'."}

manifest.rationale: Judges failed these runs due to vague or missing review rationale, not tool failure. Quotes: 'review: Reviewer marked this one a miss; no detail recorded.' and 'review: Escalated later by a different team; root cause unclear.' Decisions were made (e.g., '{"action": "partner", "confidence": 0.96}', '{"action": "route_to_ae", "confidence": 0.97}'), but the review text lacked specific facts and reasoning. No single fact entry is contradicted; the implicated entry read at v8 was later updated and is unrelated to the sparse rationale. A procedure that enforces including concrete facts and the applied rule, and forbids vague phrases, will prevent recurrences of this failure mode.

items.name: Sparse or missing reviewer rationale
items.description: Agent outputs or logs lack sufficient reviewer reasoning or detailed labels, causing decisions to be undocumented or ambiguous. This leads to missed classifications, unclear root cause analysis, and difficulty reproducing or escalating findings.
